Let \(S=T+P\). From Euler and total face-vertex incidences,
\[
S=2+\frac{60}{V}.
\]
Using the separate triangular and pentagonal incidence counts,
\[
T=\frac{3t}{V},\qquad P=\frac{5p}{V},
\]
and
\[
V(5T+3P)=480.
\]
Substitute \(P=S-T=\left(2+\frac{60}{V}\right)-T\):
\[
5T+3P=3S+2T=\frac{480}{V}.
\]
Thus
\[
T=\frac{150}{V}-3,\qquad P=5-\frac{90}{V}.
\]
For \(T,P\) to be nonnegative integers, \(V\mid 30\) and \(V\ge 18\), so \(V=30\). Then
\[
T=2,\qquad P=2.
\]
Therefore,
\[
P+T+V=2+2+30=34.
\]
\[
\boxed{34}
\]
